messages:
maya_finance: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners for the delayed usage ingestion and invoice corrections. TL;DR: undercounted tokens for ~2026-02-10 to 2026-02-14, affecting ~42 customers.

eli_engineering: Agree. I can take the ETL fix. I'll start a hotfix to prevent further delays.

sam_ops: I'll own the backfill job + validation. ETA for run: 48h once fix is deployed.

anna_cs: I'll draft customer comms and credits plan. Need list of affected invoices.

jordan_sre: I'll add alerts for ingestion latency > 10m and missing token batches. Also doc the runbook.

billing-bot: InvoiceAdjustmentsJob queued for 42 customers. JobID: JA-20260323-01

maya_finance: Owners noted: @eli_engineering (ETL), @sam_ops (backfill), @anna_cs (comms/credits), @jordan_sre (alerts/runbook). Can each confirm scope and single point of contact?

eli_engineering: Confirm. Scope: fix batch checkpointing race where seq_id got dropped. Root cause: race in consumer ack. PR in progress: https://rwd.co/pr/8841

sam_ops: Confirm. Plan: run backfill with `billing_backfill --window 2026-02-10/2026-02-14 --verify`. Will post logs and diffs to the tracker.

anna_cs: Confirm. Draft comms in doc: https://rwd.co/doc/BILL-234-comms. Will propose credits tiered by % undercount.

jordan_sre: Confirm. Adding alert AND a dashboard tile for ingestion lag and dropped batches. Will add playbook steps.

maya_finance: Timeline proposal: hotfix (0-48h), backfill + validation (48-96h), customer comms + invoice adjustments (96-144h). Any concerns?

eli_engineering: Hotfix should be <=24h if we push a config change first; full code fix 72h. Recommend config toggle to mitigate ASAP.

sam_ops: Ok. I'll prep backfill infra now; need 2 GPUs for validation job, will request quota.

anna_cs: Need a list of impacted customers + contact owners. @maya_finance can you export and drop into the doc?

maya_finance: Dropping CSV in tracker: https://rwd.co/tracker/BILL-234/impacted.csv

billing-bot: PatchInvoiceRun scheduled for 1934568920. Reminder set for 1934568920.

eli_engineering: I'll open PR for config toggle and link it in tracker.

maya_finance: Action items (short):
- ETL hotfix: eli_engineering (24h)
- Full code fix: eli_engineering (72h)
- Backfill + verify: sam_ops (48-96h)
- Customer comms + credits: anna_cs (96-144h)
- Alerts + playbook: jordan_sre (48h)

Please update the tracker when assigned. Weekly check-ins until resolved. :thumbsup: 

sam_ops: Updating tracker now. Will post run logs and failure counts.

anna_cs: I'll send a hold message to impacted customers once we have validation numbers.

jordan_sre: Setting recurring check-ins daily at 10:30 for this week in case of regressions.

maya_finance: Thanks team. We'll sync in the postmortem channel after the first backfill completes.
